summary: Aggregates wheel contact forces across all 4 wheels of the receiver vehicle for a given surface type a2. A grip factor (0.86000001, or 0.5 when this+0x32BC is non-zero) weights each wheel's contact force v24 = (grip - entry[38]) * entry[39] * 0.00012207031. Wheels are selected by matching the surface-type field at (+84 struct, +52) of their contact entry to a2. Positive forces accumulate a total, a grip/geometry-weighted term, and a 3-component direction, then the result is normalized by 1/total and stored via PerIndexStructFieldSetter(a2, 2, intensity, weighted-average, &direction).

local_names.this: receiver vehicle object carrying the contact-array pointer
local_names.a2: surface type index that wheel contacts are filtered against
local_names.v3: guard word at this+0x32BC selecting the reduced grip factor 0.5
local_names.v15: grip factor: 0.86000001 normally, 0.5 when this+0x32BC is set
local_names.v14: maximum per-wheel contact force seen this pass
local_names.v9: walker over the wheel contact array (this+0x3668), stride 62 floats
local_names.v2: accumulated total force across matching wheels
local_names.v4: accumulated weighted term (geometry x force) across matching wheels
local_names.v5/v6/v7: accumulated x/y/z components of the direction (entries 55/54/53)
local_names.v18/v19/v20: packed direction vector handed to the setter

operations.description: Zero-initialize the accumulators (v2, v4, v5, v6, v7, v14, v18/v19/v20) and set the default grip factor v15 = 0.86000001.
Read v3 = *(DWORD*)(this + 0x32BC); when non-zero, lower the grip factor to 0.5.
Walk the wheel contact array starting at this + 3482 (this+0x3668), 4 entries at a float stride of 62, counting down a do-while counter from 4.
Per-entry gate: the entry pointer is non-null AND the surface-type field ((entry+84 struct) + 52) equals a2 before the wheel is aggregated.
Compute per-wheel contact force v24 = (grip - entry[38]) * entry[39] * 0.00012207031 and track the running maximum v14.
When v24 > 0.0, accumulate total force v2 += v24, weighted term v4 += (1.1 - entry[38]*0.5 + entry[40]*0.00390625) * v24, and direction components v5/v6/v7 += v24 * entry[55]/entry[54]/entry[53].
Pack the accumulated direction components into the output slots v18 (x), v19 (y), v20 (z).
If the maximum contact force v14 > 0.001, compute the reciprocal 1.0/total, normalize the weighted average and direction by it, and clamp the intensity to 1.0 when v14 exceeds 1.0.
Store the result with PerIndexStructFieldSetter(a2, 2, intensity, normalized-weighted-average, (int)&direction).
